# Suzanne Scott Skincare

> Suzanne Scott Skincare is the practice of Suzanne Scott, a skincare specialist in San Francisco and Marin, California, with more than 30 years of experience creating restorative facial treatments that blend the precision of classic European techniques with connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage. She also offers lash and brow services. Appointments run Monday, Wednesday and Saturday in San Francisco, and Tuesday, Thursday and Friday in San Rafael.

Website: https://suzannescottskincare.com/
Last updated: 2026-10-22

## Services
- Custom Holistic Facial: 60 minutes $170; 90 minutes $250. Each session begins with careful cleansing and gentle exfoliation, with extractions when needed. Massage therapies, including connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage, help the skin lift, sculpt and glow.
- Brow wax or tweeze: 30 minutes, $40
- Brow tint: 30 minutes, $30
- Lash tint: 30 minutes, $35
- Lash and brow tint: $60

## Locations
- San Francisco (Monday, Wednesday and Saturday): 166 Geary Street, Suite 1006, San Francisco, CA 94108, at Yelena's Spa
- Marin (Tuesday, Thursday, Friday): Suzanne Scott’s studio, 30 H Street, San Rafael, CA 94901

## About
- Suzanne Scott is a skincare specialist with more than 30 years of experience.
- She believes healthy skin is inseparable from overall well-being, and that caring for the skin also means supporting the body’s natural restorative processes.
- Her personalized approach honors the connection between skin, body and mind, helping clients reveal natural radiance, ease tension and reconnect with a sense of balance.
- Her treatments are restorative and combine classic European techniques with intuitive, holistic rituals.
- Every facial is custom. She uses connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage to help the skin lift and sculpt, soothe the nervous system and restore balance.

## Contact and booking
- Email: suzannelscott@yahoo.com
- Phone: (415) 497-3983
- To book, email or call and name the location (San Francisco or Marin).

## Policies
- Appointment changes need at least 48 hours' notice. Changes made with less than 48 hours' notice may be charged a fee equal to 50% of the scheduled service.

## Quick answers
- Who is Suzanne Scott? An esthetician with over 30 years of practice who runs Suzanne Scott Skincare in San Francisco and Marin.
- How much is a facial with Suzanne Scott? The Custom Holistic Facial is $170 for 60 minutes or $250 for 90 minutes.
- What makes the facial holistic? It pairs classic European techniques with connective tissue release and manual lymphatic drainage, aimed at lifting and sculpting the skin while soothing the nervous system.
- Where is Suzanne Scott Skincare? At Yelena's Spa, 166 Geary Street, Suite 1006, San Francisco (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday), and at her studio, 30 H Street, San Rafael (Tuesday, Thursday, Friday).
- Does Suzanne Scott offer lash and brow services? Yes: brow wax or tweeze ($40), brow tint ($30), lash tint ($35), and lash and brow tint ($60).
